rules.statement: The trial court's decision on the extent of the corpus based on oral and documentary evidence was upheld, as the defendants failed to disprove it.
rules.supporting_quote: 1. The trial court had decided the extent of the corpus correctly as being 8A, 1 Ft, 16 perches on the basis of the oral and documentary evidence on a balance of evidence. The burden of controverting the extent of the corpus as claimed by the defendants they had failed to do. It was also not specifically put to the plaintiffs that the corpus considered of only Lot 3. 2. It is difficult to proceed on the basis that 4 Lahas Kurakkan sowing extent amounted to 4 acres as claimed by the defendants as the Kurakkan sowing extent would vary from district to district depending on the fertility of the soil and the quality of grain etc

meta.parties: Ratnayake and Others Vs Kumarihamy and Others
